## Chapter path “Mini chapter”

Sections in order, locked: a section opens only when the previous one is finished. `start_section(id)` gives you a section's plan, `complete_section(id, summary)` finishes it.

1. `intro` (lesson) — Introduction. Understand what we are talking about.
2. `exos` (practice) — Exercises. Apply it.
3. `bilan` (summary) — Summary. Mix it up.
